verification_scope: Pinned evidence and documented semantic reviews; not an automated proof of mathematics. Empirical verdicts require existing native evaluation with trusted live replay and full comparison. This report does not replace Natural Gate 0, IPCG, Gate A, G01 or E04.

execution_receipt.tool: installed skill scripts/verify_methods.py, read-only evidence processing
execution_receipt.meaning: Expected incomplete mathematical pool; no project code, tests or experiments executed. through=code checks evidence links only and does not authorize code generation.
execution_receipt.selection_deficit_caution: Checker field14 is min(15, qualified1)-based readiness deficit, not selected count. Actual selected=0 and remaining selection=15; PROGRESS.json records the actual count.
